capture.final_message:
Unfold the explicit typeclass terms into ordinary pointwise-set notation and prove all four component statements independently; the hypotheses in each `Iff` direction need not be used.

Use set extensionality and membership witnesses:

- \(s_1 \subseteq s_2 \Rightarrow s_1t \subseteq s_2t\): retain the same factor from \(t\) and move the first factor through the inclusion.
- \((\{a\}\cup s)^{-1}=\{a^{-1}\}\cup s^{-1}\): characterize membership in a pointwise inverse; `InvolutiveInv` supplies the needed reversal of inverse witnesses.
- \(\{x\mid xb^{-1}=1\}=\{b\}\): reduce to the group identity \(xb^{-1}=1 \iff x=b\).
- \(s/\{b\}=(x\mapsto x/b)''s\): unfold pointwise division; the singleton forces the denominator witness to equal \(b\).

Thus organize the result as an outer `And`, split both `Iff`s, and in every direction directly establish the target by extensionality, simplification of singleton/image membership, and—in the third clause—group cancellation.
